input_relations: concrete jobs by their fieldwise canonical import (Nat fields by SubNatRel, the job task by the concrete-task relation), two-way totals
lean_representation_note: the record `concrete_job` is a Lean structure with the same fields; `==` on nat is `decide (_ = _)` and on concrete tasks `decide (_ = _)` with the derived instance; the reflection lemma is the informative `∀ x y, BoolReflect (x = y) (job_eqdef x y)`; the HB `hasDecEq` registration is the derived `DecidableEq` instance
